spec.name: dependency-waves
spec.intent:
Census: complete-persona-launch of plan persona-owned-enforcement, source commit a327bd6e96f3c92d1dba0242bf886e6abc094cda. The line at d8701e45 changes only planning/design/notebook records relative to that source; the original source census still applies. The prior implementer's isolated edits are unaccepted and are not a baseline. Use a fresh isolated checkout off the line after predecessors are whole. Do not run builds/tests/linters/formatters mid-flight; main/integrator verifies the coherent unit against only its criteria. No design changes or rubric redesign are authorized.

Realize the newly handed planner role rule in the authored planning skill and planner role surface: dependencies or shared outputs may require a singleton wave; do not call that a bad cut or pad it with unchanged work. Remove the universal singleton-nonterminal-wave rejection, while retaining dependency ordering, no concurrent output/reference contention, per-dispatch capacity, factor-based splitting and proportionate acceptance. Keep the wave recurrence and lifecycle vocabulary unchanged. This is a wording/law correction, not a runtime scheduling feature: existing plan wave computation already represents serial dependencies. Update the package release note. Do not add permanent tests that merely repeat authored wording or lifecycle configuration; remove any such test introduced by this unit. Reuse existing plan-capability behavior coverage rather than inventing a source-text pin. Do not edit the host-installed skills or historical plan/design records.

Recovery source: the completed delta remains at db95c6528916fe4ba602db7d692af365d7b02eeb in /home/lex/.omp/wt/t58d1a1b3d/m. Its parent is a327bd6e96f3c92d1dba0242bf886e6abc094cda, not the bound plan tip, and the owning repository does not hold that commit. Recover that delta, without repeating the authored change, into the new native implementer actor's own actual unit worktree off the current plan line and commit with truthful recovery attribution. Land the resulting proper-base commit, not db95c652 relabeled. Keep the old clone as a read-only recovery source; do not auto-apply its patch to main or directly to the line, and do not weaken the landing classifier. The existing unit state, pin, output envelope and acceptance remain unchanged.

The actual unit worktree must share the Git common directory of the repository owning /home/lex/workspaces/cratylus.plan-persona-owned-enforcement. Copied external worktree metadata in an automatic clone is not that provenance. The note omp isolation clone is not a plan-line worktree records the observed distinction.

Execution carrier: use a fresh native implementer main session through the installed /home/lex/.omp/agent/omp-agent launcher, launched by Main from the owning plan line and addressed by this unit's name. The installed omp agent definition has the current implementer contract, including its own plan land event. Native CLI print mode is supported. This actor establishes its own real isolated unit worktree off the current line, writes artifact only there, and writes the authoritative landing through the plan capability. Its initial cwd on the line is for reading the unit and establishing the worktree, never permission to build directly on the line. The ordinary role, guard hooks, model routing and independent assay remain in force; disable none of them.

Do not resume a clone-constrained actor to modify the original repository: BuildDependencyWaves has an injected NEVER-modify-outside-clone instruction, which this spec cannot override. The installed task-dispatch hook unconditionally sets isolated:true for named implementer tasks, so isolated:false on the same task route is not sufficient. A native main-session launcher is a distinct supported execution carrier with the correct workspace authority, not an escape from the prior worker's boundary. Main owns invoking that new carrier; the planner neither launches an actor from the restricted clone nor performs artifact recovery. The integrator does not impersonate the implementer's landing. If the native launcher encounters an actual authentication/runtime restriction, report its precise failure before claiming this alternate carrier is unavailable. Only binary, launcher and role availability have been observed; no model run or successful recovery is claimed by the planner.

Acceptance rectification: the original demand for a permanent wording/configuration-echo test was a planner defect against the repository testing contract supplied by Main. This is a declarative law correction, not a changed runtime algorithm. Its mechanical delta is checked from the bounded source diff; the independent assayer determines conformance to the unchanged pinned planner-role shard. Existing runtime behavior coverage at packages/runtime/test/plan.test.ts:720-749 exercises add/bind/show over a real dependency chain and already expects singleton wave 0 followed by singleton wave 1. It is a preservation check, not evidence that the wording change was implemented. No new echo test, duplicated behavioral test or live-model test is required. Deletion of packages/canon/test/planner-waves.test.ts remains within the output envelope because this unit introduced it; do not recreate it to satisfy the superseded criteria.
accept: The bounded artifact diff removes or replaces the unconditional singleton-nonterminal-wave rejection in the authored plan skill and updates the planner role surface without changing the wave recurrence, runtime algorithm or lifecycle configuration. This change criterion fails on the old source containing the universal rejection; a passing pre-existing runtime test alone does not satisfy it. Shard conformance is the independent assayer's verdict, not an assertion that the authored strings equal the implementer's expectations.

No permanent source-wording/configuration-echo test is introduced or retained by this unit. The package changeset documents the correction. Existing plan-capability dependency-chain behavior coverage remains intact; the main/integrator runs it with the existing formal-block/symbol, type and whole checks as appropriate. Do not duplicate the already covered dependency transition, repin copied configuration values, or require a native harness/model run for this wording change.
